caption: A close-up view looks down into a white bowl holding a pool of yellow liquid arranged as an open, U-shaped ring. A paler, foamy mass fills the upper arc. Thinner liquid spreads toward the lower edge. For the first stretch the bowl and its contents remain visually unchanged, with no tool present. Then a metal knife blade, its serrated edge catching the light, enters from the lower right. It presses its tip into the foamy mass and is drawn back and forth across the pool, its insertion point shifting among the right side, center, and left. As it passes, the pale mass and surrounding liquid are locally displaced and deformed, pushed aside and dragged along the surface. The ring outline persists, and the blade's angle and contact point change frame to frame, marking continuous sweeping. The sweeping motion carries on through the final frames. The blade remains in contact with the pool, and the displaced mass remains visibly disturbed around it.
